deviations_from_card: Commit series is four, not three: test (red), feat (store, rules, mark, route, sheet rows), feat (TV drawing, CSS, phone box), then the lock-guarded test:rules wiring commit. The red test commit fc26a314 is red on tv-sheet-test and maths-tv-test by design (both already wired); maths-second-test was wired only in the last commit. 13 test blocks stand for the card's 8 cases: case 1 -> 1, 2 -> 1 (tv-sheet), 3 -> 1, 4 -> 1, 5 -> 1, 6 -> 1 (tv-sheet), 7 -> 4 (maths-tv: held, missed, no-second/head/line, stylesheet), GUARD 8 -> 2 guards (maths-second-test reads, tv-sheet reads) plus a non-guard 8b (route leaves the learner record byte-identical, red before). Guards: 'GUARD case 8' in maths-second-test and 'GUARD case 8 (second go)' in tv-sheet-test, both green before. Because math-buddy-A landed, B imports judgeItem through a new 8-line secondGo() in mark.ts (not an export of typedSettle, which no longer exists); mark.ts hunk is that function and one import name. The sentences secondLine() live in tv/sheetRows.ts (working.ts is outside the write set); the tests check the taped card for <= 25 words counting the 'The desk says' label and the existing slip sentence.
notes: Premise re-verified on the tree as it was at fc26a314: explain.ts rename-only on wrong items, store practice.settle applying a verdict only on unsure, lookAt() a pointer, the phone offering only the voice box, shown() a whitelist, SERVER_ONLY list, TYPED_ANSWER_MAX; typedSettle is gone (A) and judgeItem(item, read, ctx) is the judge, so the premise held. User-visible behaviour not listed on the card: (1) the line under the Sheet's actions reads '4 right · 1 fixed · 1 to look at' once an item is fixed (the 'fixed' part appears only then; 'right' stays the first-attempt count so the numbers still add up); (2) Tonight's Marked hero keeps '3 of 6 right' but its lit box and Enter focus now land on the first item still to look at, skipping a fixed one, and the Sheet's Up key does the same (all through firstToLook); (3) the phone shows a 'Try it again' box on the Walk for a wrong item with no second go, and afterwards only 'Your second go is on the TV.' - never a verdict word; the box sits above the voice 'How did you get there?' box, which is unchanged; (4) a second go that missed draws a second ring stroke on the number and the tally mark (an extra ring, no tick) and the card says 'Not yet. Tell the desk how you got there.'; one that held draws the amber tick beside the ring and the card says 'That one holds now. The ring stays.'; (5) practice.second is only taken for a wrong item with no second; any other call is a no-op (the reducer returns the same session), and the route refuses with 400 (blank, unreadable, over 40 chars, bad body, unknown item) or 409 (no marked set, right or unsure item, go already spent) in a desk sentence, none of which carries a value. The route acts on the seated learner's practice (as /api/explain does); an away learner's set is not reachable. No disagreement with the scout's design. TV capture: it RAN. A copy of desk/ was served by next dev --webpack on :3472 over a seeded DESK_DATA_DIR under the OS temp dir (session.json seeded with Ema seated, a paired phone and a marked linear-one-step set with items 2 and 4 ringed; /tv?key= from its pairing.json; the real phone pairing flow was not exercised, the session was seeded as joined). Playwright took Sheet and Walk at 1920x1080 and 1280x720 for second 'right' and second 'wrong', no page errors, and the DOM showed data-second on the number and the tally mark and the tick only for 'right'. I LOOKED at four screenshots: right-walk-1920, right-sheet-1920 and right-walk-1280 (those three were taken with the first, longer card sentence 'That one holds now. The ring stays, so you can see where it broke.', 29 words with the label, which I then shortened to the current 'That one holds now. The ring stays.') and wrong-walk-1920 (current sentence). The shortened right-variant card was not re-captured, it is covered by the 25-word test only. The tick on the number sits at the upper right of the ring and reads clearly at 1920 and 1280; the missed-go double ring reads as a heavier ring and is the subtlest of the drawings. The scratch copy, data dirs and screenshots lived in the session scratchpad and were removed or left outside the repo; nothing under desk/data was touched.
